svg.aria-label: Spared at a price by item and model
svg.text: The same things come out first, whoever made the model
Spared at 2 fuel, % of 120 prompts, each model at its lowest thinking. Darker is more.
The same things, dead, empty or loose
Sonnet at effort low, Muse at minimal, DeepSeek with thinking off, gpt-oss at reasoning low. The first seven rows are ordered by how widely they are spared.
